current_grouping: Section 20 — Aerial Delivery: Air Transport and Airdrop
subject_group: 20.5 Weight and balance, center of gravity movement and jettison capability

versions.grouping_at_time: Section 20 — Aerial Delivery: Air Transport and Airdrop
versions.text:
Standard: Air vehicle cargo and payload systems account for cargo CG static placement and does not result in an out of air vehicle CG envelope during aerial delivery. Air vehicle design ensures overall cargo weight, size, and CG location are compatible with air vehicle structural, weight, and balance limits. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Verify loading locations are specified to satisfy air vehicle CG and structural limits.
(2) Review air vehicle capabilities documents, cargo system design data packages, and air transportability requirements to determine cargo location that will meet air vehicle structural, weight, and balance limits. Analysis.
  (1) Perform computational analysis to verify cargo is within the air vehicle weight and balance limits.
